blocks.text: KYIV, Ukraine — Mykola Kasiuk’s world plunged into near-total darkness when a land mine exploded on the battlefield with Russian troops. The Ukrainian soldier lost an eye. He clings to hope that one day he will see with the other because he can still discern faint traces of light. After two years and numerous operations, Kasiuk placed that hope with a visiting team of U.S. surgeons.
